terminals.name: explorer-backend
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ -d ../explorer ]; then cd ../explorer && exec uv run python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000; else echo 'explorer repository not checked out; nothing to run'; fi
terminals.description: CoMaps Explorer Django (django-ninja) REST API at http://localhost:8000 (OpenAPI docs at /api/docs). Runs only when the sibling explorer repo is present. Build the desktop app once via .cursor/install.sh, then run it on a display with: cd comaps && DISPLAY=:1 $HOME/omim-build-release/CoMaps
